summary: Atmos Energy filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing an underwriting agreement with BNP Paribas, Credit Agricole CIB and U.S. Bancorp Investments as representatives for the sale of $700 million of 6.000% senior notes due 2036. Net proceeds are estimated at roughly $691.4 million after discounts and expenses, with closing expected October 9, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The notes sit under a 2009 indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee, terms set by an officers certificate. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch rate sensitivity of proceeds deployment.
